meta.title: An upcoming event can be seen but not bid on
gaps: Whether individual bid-sheet cells are read-only while the event is upcoming if the vendor screen exposes no stable cell-level control state
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Whether individual bid-sheet cells are read-only while the event is upcoming if the vendor screen exposes no stable cell-level control state

steps.note: Open the API-prepared upcoming RFQ without creating or publishing another event.
Move to Vendor A's supplier-portal view while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the upcoming RFQ from the vendor event list and land on its pricing sheet.
Verify the vendor sees that the event has not started.
Verify the event's start-time information is shown to the vendor.
Attempt to type a bid price and require the vendor sheet to reject the edit if it is read-only.
Attempt submission and require the product to refuse it before the event start time.
